consumption_combined_wh_per_km.notes: Edmunds EV Range Test of the Sierra EV Max Range Denali (24-in wheels, 200+ kWh pack): 507 mi, 48.1 kWh/100 mi x 10/1.609344 = 299 Wh/km, 60/40 city/highway mix at 40 mph average, 58 F. Combined-style figure, not steady highway. Independent test, not a rating (B97). Model year 2025 is not stated on the cited pages (InsideEVs, Jalopnik); Edmunds, the original, blocks fetches. Energy basis: at the charger / wall-to-wheels, since 48.1 kWh/100 mi x 507 mi = 244 kWh exceeds the 205 kWh pack, so it sits beside EPA-style figures, not beside the pack-side Hummer figure.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Estimated (B103): NRCan's highway rating for its twin, the 2025 Chevrolet Silverado EV WT Max Range (same 24-module Ultium pack, dual motor). The Denali is heavier and rides on 24-inch wheels, so likely higher. Edmunds' combined test (299 Wh/km, at the charger) is on the combined field.

range_km.notes: GM estimate 460 mi. Manufacturer estimate, not an EPA/NRCan rating (B97).

wheels.notes: Jalopnik: the Sierra EV Denali Max Range tested by Edmunds is "only available with 24-inch wheels"; model year not stated on the page.
